name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
provider: Department of School Education & Literacy, Ministry of Education
description: Central sector scheme to award scholarships to meritorious students of economically weaker sections to arrest dropouts at Class 8 and encourage them to continue study at secondary stage (Classes 9 to 12).

eligibility_criteria.notes: Parental income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 3,50,000/- per annum.
Awarded for studying in Classes 9 through 12.
Students of KVS, NVS, and private/residential schools are excluded.

required_documents.description: Student Aadhaar or Aadhaar enrolment slip.
Student bank account linked with Aadhaar for DBT.

benefits.description: Scholarship of Rs. 12,000/- per annum (Rs. 1,000/- per month) paid directly into the student bank account via DBT.

application_period.notes: Verified against official guidelines. Window status: closed.

evidence.supporting_excerpt: Students whose parental income from all sources is not more than Rs. 3,50,000/- per annum are eligible to avail the scholarships.
evidence.source_title: NMMSS Official Scheme Guidelines - Ministry of Education

evidence.supporting_excerpt: The amount of scholarship is Rs. 12,000/- per annum (Rs. 1000/- per month) from class IX to XII.
evidence.source_title: NMMSS Official Scheme Guidelines - Ministry of Education

evidence.supporting_excerpt: The student must study as regular student in Government, Government-aided and local body schools.
evidence.source_title: NMMSS Official Scheme Guidelines - Ministry of Education

evidence.supporting_excerpt: Students must have minimum of 55% marks or equivalent grade in Class VIII examination (relaxable by 5% for SC/ST students).
